legacyTouchDiagnosis.finding: Legacy Android9 input swipe changes downTime on successive moves. The pinned PanZoomController drops continuations whose downTime differs from ACTION_DOWN. Corrected CI shell tool retains one downTime and injects via Android InputManager; no product input acceptance rule or scroll assertion was relaxed.

backgroundTimingDefinition: From immediately before Home injection until before foreground relaunch, includes OS transition overhead; >=5 seconds are waited after confirming foreground loss.
